Pursuant to SEBI Circular No. SEBI/HO/CFD/CFD-PoD-1/P/CIR/2023/123 dated July 13, 2023, we made the following disclosures to Stock Exchanges regarding ongoing litigations/disputes:
1. On July 20, 2023, we informed that AXISCADES Aerospace & Technologies Private Limited, a Wholly Owned Subsidiary (hereinafter referred to as the Company) has received a stay from the Honorable High Court of Karnataka, with respect to the proceedings initiated by the Income Tax Department for the fiscal year 2014-15 u/s 147, read with Section 144 and 144B of the Income Tax Act, with respect to the admissibility of capital loss in the income tax returns pertaining to the said fiscal year.
2. On December 04, 2023, we informed that the application made by the Company before the Court of District Judge 2 Pune, vide Civil MA No 264/2022, praying for setting aside the Order dated 20/08/2021, passed by the Sole Arbitrator, has been dismissed with Costs. The Companys Legal Counsels were assessing the implications of the said order and considering appealing in higher courts of Law.
For the purpose of filling the details under the column - date of initiation of the litigation/dispute, we have considered the date of intimation to the Stock Exchanges.
